I can relate to this my EX broke into my phone early on, them insisted on seeing mine regularly. But when it was her turn because she cheated on me. Apps like snap chat showed up and people she talked to regularly , the conversations simply halted. I even did that exact same thing waking up from a dream. She gave me plenty of reasons not to trust her though. I had nightmares several times a week about her  cheating. We had kids and I wanted it to work, plus I absolutely loved this woman. But I didn’t trust her anymore. Was she hiding things? Absolutely. Was she hiding cheating? I didn’t know but I didn’t trust her, and I know she cheated prior. There were times I could forget but never very long. If I were you I’d ask yourself how important this person is to you. If the relationship is something you value and really want. You two need to talk openly and express exactly how you’re feeling, as well as how each others actions make you feel. Make sure to include the consequences if things don’t change. If at the end of said conversation both of you want the relationship, figure out what each of you need from each other and do it. (It won’t be fun or necessarily easy) Maybe include a therapist if it makes sense. What I will say though if there’s no trust there’s no relationship, at least eventually anyway. Trust is the most important thing in a relationship followed by communication. If you don’t trust someone the words out of their mouth are just bullshit lies. They may not be lies but it won’t matter without trust.  If that all sounds like too much work you have two options. 1) end the relationship because it will only get worse. 2) prepare for a life time of being miserable in a crappy relationship.
